deadline.value: Fall entry only: December 1 for all applicants; year inferred for Fall 2027.

supervisor.value: Name potential supervisors on your application and contact them first; faculty members nominate the students they want to supervise for admission.
supervisor.quote: Faculty members then nominate students they would like to supervise for acceptance into the program. | You should contact faculty members with matching research interests before applying to determine their availability.

funding.value: Funding packages (awards, TA and RA positions) are offered at admission to most thesis-based PhD students; no guaranteed amount is stated.
funding.quote: Funding packages are generally available for students in thesis-based programs. | teaching and research assistantships are offered at the time of admission to most students to allow them to focus on their research and studies.

entry_route.value: A master's in psychology or a closely related field is required; bachelor's holders enter through the MA.
entry_route.quote: Master's degree in psychology or its equivalent in a closely related discipline.

notes: Behavioural neuroscience is one of four research areas in the Psychology PhD.
name: Psychology (PhD), behavioural neuroscience area
